kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp attach-asset-group-to-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz0000 --asset-group-list Type=waf MemberUid=1743970208320000 Region=cn-hangzhou Name=waf-test-001 --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
